title: Bird Feeder Quiet-Day Alert
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder detections (`birdfeeder:detection`), doorbell/package events (`doorbell:event`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and home-life sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birdfeeder:detection
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as visits by feeder _time
| eventstats avg(visits) as avg_visits by feeder
| where avg_visits>0 AND visits=0
| sort feeder _time
description: Flags feeder days with zero visits despite a normal baseline, which is a good way to catch empty food, dead cameras, or a sudden shift in bird behaviour.
value: A quiet feeder can mean a fun wildlife mystery or just a maintenance issue; either way, it is worth noticing.
implementation: Forward detections from your bird-feeder camera or model; review zero-visit days and confirm the feeder is stocked and working.
visualization: Daily feeder activity grid with zero-visit days highlighted.
grandmaExplanation: It maps when a bird feeder that normally gets visitors suddenly goes very quiet for the day.
